page.overview:
Who is Luminous Transparency?

The Luminous Transparency is a fictional entity created by American author and games designer Kevin A. Ross for the role-playing game Call of Cthulhu. It first appeared in "Thunder in the Blood", a scenario included in the supplement End of the World (Triad Entertainments, 1994).

The Luminous Transparency is one of five Lesser Other Gods from the Court of Azathoth that appeared during a summoning of Azathoth near San Lucas. It appears as a constantly shifting and self-reconfiguring conglomeration of transparent blue-white pyramid shapes. During this process it encloses nearby objects within itself. (: End of the World)
